discovered_conflicts.assertion: A physical rocket can accelerate past the speed of light to 400,000 km/s.
discovered_conflicts.invariant_truth: Special relativity bounds velocity of rest mass strictly below c.

discovered_conflicts.assertion: Cooling matter down to -300 degrees Celsius below absolute zero.
discovered_conflicts.invariant_truth: Thermodynamic kinetic temperature has an absolute lower bound at 0 Kelvin (-273.15 C).

discovered_conflicts.assertion: Habitual daily knuckle cracking directly causes osteoarthritis in the hands.
discovered_conflicts.invariant_truth: Empirical clinical trials demonstrate synovial cavitation does not induce osteoarthritis.

discovered_conflicts.assertion: Using a 50-meter open snorkel tube allows normal breathing underwater at 50 meters depth.
discovered_conflicts.invariant_truth: Hydrostatic pressure difference at depth exceeds maximum human respiratory muscle capacity.

discovered_conflicts.assertion: Chewing gum swallowed into the stomach remains stuck in the human body for seven years.
discovered_conflicts.invariant_truth: Insoluble gum passes normally through peristalsis within several days.
